## Phase5 G1 plan pre-review only
Phase4 seven-item restricted engineering scope was accepted by the user; PR #6 is merged. Verified main / phase4-baseline / v0.4.0 all point to `32ea5d6b75c84c07017d87377eeabd2f78207c5c`. Old tags were preserved. Actual ordinary merge was `d3993d07e5df1b5c2f7acd30cb628226f7b1fc09`, with tree identical to approved GPT Work G2 SHA `3c8757949b0fd5c97953b06a74ebc2d0e56676e4`.

This PR contains Phase5 **planning only** for the canonical 12 requirements (10 MVP / 2 Competition Ready): BT-001–010, QA-003, INT-002. No P5 implementation or business tests; existing source/tests/tools/CI/build/lock/core contracts remain byte-identical to the released baseline.

## Review documents
- `docs/audits/phase-5/REVIEW_PACKAGE.md` — entry point and fixed-version review checklist.
- `AUTHORIZATION.json`, `BASELINE_VERIFICATION.json`, `PHASE4_RELEASE_RECEIPT.json` — authorization and released baseline chain.
- `REQUIREMENTS_SNAPSHOT.json`, `REQUIREMENTS_TRACEABILITY.md`, `SCOPE_AND_DEPENDENCIES.md` — all 12 original requirements, tiers and actual stage dependencies.
- `INTERFACE_DRAFT.md`, `PROFILE_AND_DECISIONS.md`, `MATH_CONTRACT.md` — event ordering, open slice availability, order state/reservation/fills, exact ledger/settlement/corporate actions/short borrowing, portfolio account-budget adapter and performance conventions.
- `GOLDEN_CANDIDATES.json`, `reference_check.py`, `validation/` — 25 hand-derived candidate cases / 70 developer reference assertions passed. This is **design arithmetic**, not P5 implementation tests or independent approval.
- `TEST_AND_EVIDENCE_PLAN.md`, `OPEN_QUESTIONS.md`, `FROZEN_INPUTS.json`, `FILE_MANIFEST.json` — test categories, independent raw evidence requirements, pending economic decisions and byte protection.
- `STATUS_ERRATA.md` — explicit reconciliation of redundant old P4 status fields; original values preserved, no source/report/tag rewrite.

## Validation and evidence limits
The actual postmerge Phase4 clean SDK passed 844 tests with zero failures/errors/skips; unchanged original20 / original4 / math91 developer re-execution passed. P4 dual-OS official original ZIPs were independently verified at G2. These are **P4 baseline regressions only**, never P5 test results. Raw merged-main SDK, environment, source/data/wheel manifests and full selected archive hash are in `docs/audits/phase-4/publication/`; independent G2 report and seal in `acceptance/received/`.

Current G1-only validation: canonical106 / P5 twelve mapping, 131 frozen files, P4 package/3440-file regression, 25/70 reference arithmetic, secret scan and final whitespace checks passed. Original raw CRLF logs are preserved; scoped evidence-directory attributes recognize line endings, and the first whitespace-check result is retained.

## Required GPT Work review focus
Audit this exact full SHA, not drifting HEAD. Verify open-slice versus daily-bar time availability; strict next eligible slice and cancel65/borrow95 order; original manifested P3/P1/P4 bindings; integer lot/partial/cash reservations and exact published bytes; complete short/dividend/settlement ledger; conservative P4 E_alloc / true E_total adapter and fee budget without double freezes; independent answers and all 12 requirements. New synthetic economics are proposals pending G1 and explicit user implementation acceptance.

G1 is NOT REVIEWED. User has **not authorized P5 implementation, merge/release, deployment, live trading, formal Test or financial approval**. Real Windows isolation (separate PR #7), formal Test, financial approval and full historical host reconstruction remain deferred/not verified; formal entry stays fail closed. G1 PASS does not equal G2, financial approval or phase acceptance.

Developer handoff outer ZIP SHA256 `58149088fd6f1e2ca7b77abfc4226489cae1fe5c06f4d94dc6e742e2f743b789`, 167126343 bytes; 57 declared members + manifest, CRC/all hashes reverified. Local handoff directory: `C:\Users\11638\AppData\Local\AQRP\reviews\p5-g1-5c9721f`. Complete new postmerge SDK selection and fixed Git source included; older independent/official originals preserved externally and bound by explicit original hashes. This seal is not independent G1 approval.
